digest: 早上好 ☀️ 今天是 2026-11-23。以下是为你汇总的早报内容。

items.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
items.summary: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.

items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.summary: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

items.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

items.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
items.summary: MedChemBench evaluates how well AI models interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and select compounds in early drug discovery.

items.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
items.summary: Learn how OpenAI built the Performance Factory, a system of Codex-powered workflows that finds and fixes performance issues to help keep ChatGPT fast.
